insights.one_liner: Soho House & Co runs members' clubs, hotels and restaurants worldwide; its Amsterdam house is an IND sponsor with an English-friendly service job.

culture.text: A members' club company with houses, hotels and restaurants in cities around the world.

open.text: Soho House Amsterdam B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, a customer service role in Amsterdam, doesn't require Dutch.

worth_knowing.text: Soho House & Co left the stock market after a USD 9.00 per share takeover deal.
